run_config.note: Flip+sparse-hop Metropolis sampler for Exp24 grand-potential model; local offsets are idealised field modes

stack: 1 calibrate in equilibrium at operating point
2 select qualified subset by post-crosstalk margin
3 compile target into global cut + local offsets/frequency slots
6 correct local offsets/pulse schedule within bounded retries
7 freeze/hold (remove drive, D0 or deep-margin hold)

full_control_gates.address: post-crosstalk nearest-address margin >= 8 noise units for charge bits (Exp24 corrected criterion) or distinct nonzero quantum couplings with control time << coherence
full_control_gates.set: marginal target probability >=0.95 per element before declaring a register element controlled
full_control_gates.hold: total write/verify latency < retention or coherence budget/10
full_control_gates.read: read error at least 10x below register error budget (not yet measured for charge atoms)
full_control_gates.couple: conditional operation demonstrated without destroying address margins
full_control_gates.scale: whole-register exact success, not mean bit accuracy alone, meets the declared budget

layers.layer: charge atoms in 60 nm cell body (Exp24/35)
layers.verdict: best atomic charge layer; multi-bit result is Exp35 Part A; readout is predicted (~7% current step), not simulated as a measured detector

layers.stored: n=1 in 60/60 trials at 0.81-0.90 V and n=2 in 40/40 at 0.95-1.00 V (KMC model)
layers.verdict: atomic-width conductance count is current-programmable in model; atom positions are stochastic, not individually placed

layers.stored: seed placement +30 mV: 10/10 in seed; step count exact k=2 in 20/20 ring fields at 1.05-1.1 V; winner identity only 65-79% by best predictor
layers.verdict: count and birth site are programmable; arbitrary winner identity needs sequential feedback/repair, not one global step
only stored route that passes addressability + control-time + storage together at small N (model anchored to measured T2/literature)
fails full control by storage leakage from nearest-neighbour 29Si dimers, despite addressability and Lie-algebra controllability in principle

universal_control_scorecard.thermodynamic_margin_law: For independent logistic bits, whole-register success S=prod_i p_i; a common per-bit margin m (logit units) needs approximately m >= ln(N/(1-S)) for large m. Correlated/global drives can fall far below this product (tested in UC4).
